comment: R16 item 4a (ruling D1): rows of the r6/r9/r10/r13/r14 self-ruling tests and s2-deny-trace whose outcome changed when ruling.ts was cut down to the plain literal-path deny plus the flat ask trigger (a write surface + the token `ruling` + a handoff-dir path on the lexed line). Each row keeps its test name and runs through the real adapter (test/_r11rig.ts) with a stubbed reviewer. Placeholders: {up} and {own} handoff dirs where this session is the child, {down} one where it is the parent, {hand} the handoffs root, {root} the project (the session cwd), {S} a scratch dir in the project. Every path goes through inBash. expect: ask = the self-ruling ask fires (rule self-ruling): a denying stub denies, an allowing stub allows, with one model call each; none = no self-ruling refusal or ask any more, `outcome` is what the adapter does now with an allowing stub (pass = no overlay record; allow = another overlay ask the reviewer allowed; deny = a deterministic overlay deny); refused = the plain-path deny, no model call.
